comment: Canonical brief shape used by tools-imagekit-plan.py. Missing fields are inferred from the brief text; anything still unknown is reported as an open question rather than invented.

project.description: Stable project or campaign identifier used in filenames.

title.description: Human title of the requested asset.

audience.description: Who the image is for; drives tone, complexity and legibility.

subject.description: What must be visible. Multiple subjects may be listed.

dimensions.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels; inferred from output_use when absent.

format.description: png, jpg, webp, tiff, gif, pdf.

copy.description: Headline, subhead, CTA strings when text is rendered.

references.description: Reference images for structure, palette or material only.

rights_context.description: Known licence, consent or brand-permission context.

open_question_rules: subject is empty -> ask what must be visible before generating
audience is empty -> ask who the image is for
dimensions and output_use both empty -> default to web-hero 1920x1080 and report the assumption
text_in_image true but copy empty -> ask for the exact strings, never invent customer-facing copy
references given without rights_context -> flag that reference rights are unverified

technical: file opens in the target application
colour mode and transparency match the delivery spec
visual: no tangencies on the subject outline
text legible at target display size
brand: palette within tolerance of brand colours
safety: no identifiable real person without consent
no protected marks reproduced without rights
